newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's two Bondes rates mixed at auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's two Bondes rates mixed at auction.

text.p: The rate on Mexican government 364-day development bonds, or Bondes, rose 0.02 percentage points to 1.34 percent above the one-month Cetes rate at Tuesday's primary auction, dealers estimated.
The 364-day Bondes were assigned at 98.80641 pesos.
Demand for the Bondes was 1.825 billion pesos compared to the 500 million offered by the Banco de Mexico.
The rate on the 728-day Bondes fell 0.02 percentage points to 1.45 percent above the 28-day Cetes rate.
The 728-day Bondes were assigned at 97.68667 pesos. Demand for the 728-day Bondes was 1.55 billion pesos compared to the 600 million offered by Banco de Mexico.
